quirks.condition: Any accepted record's base fee is rounded from amount times rate in basis points to whole cents.
quirks.effect: JPY records round half-up; ST records in other currencies round half-to-even; RF records in other currencies truncate toward zero. The spec says nearest cent for all.

quirks.condition: Any accepted record at tier T007.
quirks.effect: The rate applied is 245 basis points, not the published 250.

quirks.condition: The transaction date falls on a Saturday or Sunday and the MCC is in the range 5960 to 5969 inclusive.
quirks.effect: A surcharge of 25 basis points of the amount, rounded half-up to cents, is added to the fee before the cap. The spec has no surcharge.

quirks.condition: The currency is EUR and the amount is strictly greater than 5,000,000 cents.
quirks.effect: A levy of 10 basis points of the amount, rounded half-up to cents, is added to the fee before the cap; an amount of exactly 5,000,000 cents pays no levy. The spec has no levy.

quirks.condition: Any accepted record at tier T009.
quirks.effect: The 250,000-cent fee cap is not applied; all other tiers are capped.

quirks.condition: The 11-digit amount field (columns 13 to 23) contains leading spaces before the digits.
quirks.effect: Leading spaces are read as leading zeros and the record is accepted; a space anywhere after the first digit, or an all-space field, is rejected ERRAMT. The spec requires zero padding.

quirks.condition: The amount sign at column 12 is minus.
quirks.effect: RF records are accepted with the fee and net computed on the absolute amount as if the sign were plus; ST records with a minus sign are rejected ERRAMT.

quirks.condition: A date of February 29 in a year divisible by 4 but not by 400, such as 1900 or 2100.
quirks.effect: The date is accepted: leap years are every year divisible by 4 with no century correction.

quirks.condition: A batch containing at least one rejected record ahead of an accepted one.
quirks.effect: All accepted records' output lines are emitted first in input order, then all rejected records' lines in input order, then the trailer; the trailer counts and fee sum are unaffected.

unmapped_families.reason: Held-out mixed corpus exercising every quirk together with spec-accurate paths; no single quirk maps to it.
